results.test: F01: fails confirm-upload with 404 'Document not found' when uploading LTA task document in ALL view
results.findings: Characterizes the exact bug: resolveEntity lacks documents lookup, falls back to user's first entity ('ATA'), causing confirmUpload to query entity_id = 'ent-ata' for an LTA record and return 404 Not Found.

results.test: F02: document still shows in list queries despite 404 confirm failure
results.findings: Proves why the document still shows: Step 1 (createDocument) already wrote metadata to DB and Step 2 uploaded binary to cloud storage. List queries do not filter by status = active.

results.test: F03: download-url preview fails with 409 Conflict because status remains stuck in pending_upload
results.findings: Shows downstream impact: document remains in pending_upload status, blocking download and inline preview with 409 Conflict.

results.test: F04: subsequent document mutations (archive, comments) also fail with 404 for LTA records in ALL view
results.findings: Proves that all document mutation routes (/comments, /archive, /unarchive, /lifecycle, PUT /) suffer from the identical entity resolution omission when active entity is ALL.
